name: Impro Precision Industries Limited
summary: Impro Precision Industries Limited, established in 1998 and headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, designs, makes and distributes advanced castings and precision-machined components for customers in the United States, Europe and China. Its segments are investment casting, precision machining, sand casting and surface treatment such as plating, anodizing and painting. Its parts go into vehicles, engines, hydraulic systems, construction and farm machinery, aerospace and medical devices, and it also runs logistics and warehousing centers.
